name: junkd
description: The frame over the junk-drawer marketplace: /junkd (and the ✚ junkd segment under the prompt) toggles one pane with the marketplace's plugins (on/off at user scope), the main settings of handoff, orch and tldr through their $ nouns, and the enabled plugins' commands. Every feature plugin works without it.

output_style.title: Output style
output_style.description: At session start, once per plugin version: make junkd:STE (Simplified Technical English) the output style when ~/.claude/settings.json has no outputStyle yet. off skips the step; a style you chose is never touched either way.
